author: DonaldMyTrump
body:
Hello staff members, my name is YouCantCMe aka Zac.

This is an appeal for a kick I recieved. GrapeSmoothie previously posted
"Hello Zac, 

Please refer to your last appeal. I will look into this situation and look for those others you mentioned but just because someone else is doing it doesn't give you the right to do so as well. Next time please report these users and provide evidence so we can punish said players.

Appeal denied

Regards,
GrapeSmoothie, Senior Moderator"

In my appeal but the thing is I asked Pizza the leader of Apollo if I could do inappropriate things in his scrim server previously, which is when users are allowed to do these things. Since users on the team that were running the scrim server were breaking the rules it would be safe to assume it is allowed, Aura decided just to punish me and not members of his own team though, please check logs and you will see this is true. Thanks. I'd also appreciate it if you would stop locking these quite so fast so I have a chance to respond without making more posts.

title: Appeal for my kick

replies.author: GrapeSmoothie
replies.body:
Hello Zac,

I have checked through the chat logs thoroughly and I have seen no other players behaving in an inappropriate manor as you were. In my eyes Aura did have a reason to kick you and from what I have seen, his teammates were not behaving in such a way that they would be punished for. From what I have seen, Aura has punished players who were misbehaving on that scrim server around the time you were punished. Feel free to message me over skype if you have anymore concerns or anything you would like to add to your situation.

Appeal Denied


Regards,
GrapeSmoothie, Senior Moderator
